Trekv4 6.0 is a ground-up rework of the watchface. The LCARS frame is now **drawn by the watch in code** instead of being shipped as a set of pre-made pictures, and nearly everything else in this release follows from that: a live, tap-to-recolor preview in Settings, all seven Pebble watch families maintained from one set of shapes, and full control over the color of every piece of the frame.

### Drawn in code, not pictures
- **The LCARS frame is drawn live on the watch.** Each of its 13 pieces is described as shape data (rounded rectangles and elbows) and drawn with smooth, anti-aliased edges, instead of being loaded from one full-screen picture per color theme.
- **One design for every watch.** Rectangular watches and Pebble Round 2 no longer need their own set of theme pictures for each screen size. Each watch gets a layout tuned to its screen from the same shape data, so a design change is made once instead of once per watch and per theme.
- **Every piece can be any color.** Because nothing is baked into a picture, any of the 13 frame pieces, the text, the background, the Bluetooth symbol and the battery bars can each take their own color.
- **Sharper artwork.** The Bluetooth symbol now matches the original Trekv4/Trekv5 artwork pixel for pixel (earlier versions drew a blurry approximation) and scales up cleanly on larger screens.
- Pebble Time Round keeps its original picture-based frame, so its frame pieces can't be recolored individually. Text, background and battery colors still can.

### Redesigned Settings with a live preview
- **A live preview stays pinned at the top of Settings** while you scroll. Every change (theme, colors, layout, date format, language, weather on/off, inversion) redraws it instantly, before anything is sent to the watch.
- **On Pebble Time 2 the preview is the watch's own drawing, reproduced pixel for pixel.** The phone runs a faithful JavaScript translation of the watchface's drawing code and of PebbleOS's graphics and text routines, so what you see is what the watch will show. Other models use a close vector preview.
- **Tap to recolor.** Tap a frame piece, the text, the background, the Bluetooth symbol or the battery bars to open the standard Pebble color picker. Cancel and nothing changes.
- **New "Custom" theme** alongside the 11 classic presets (Classic blue, Light blues, Purples, Yellows, White, Greys, Reds, Yellow and blue, Blue/purple/red/orange, Greens, Dark blues, Borg). Black-and-white watches get a Classic monochrome theme plus a custom black-and-white option.
- **Only relevant options are shown.** Heart rate appears only on watches with a heart-rate sensor, steps only on watches that count them, and the color picker offers 64 colors or just black and white to match the watch.
- **Reorganized into clear sections:** Appearance, Custom frame pieces, Battery, Information and layout, Weather, Alerts and Language, written in everyday words with short explanations.
- **Choose what goes in the corners:** seconds or AM/PM in the upper right (AM/PM hides itself in 24-hour mode), heart rate or a short date in the bottom left, step count or an extra date in the bottom right, and an option to show the date inside the LCARS bracket.
- **Battery bars:** choose what shows behind them (black, the LCARS theme, or the screen background) and, optionally, your own colors for full and empty bars. The classic white bars stay the default.
- **Preview-only helpers** let you check a 24-hour clock and the "Bluetooth disconnected" alert on your phone without changing anything on the watch.
- Nothing is sent until you tap **Save Settings**, and your existing settings and colors carry over from earlier versions automatically.
- The Settings page is now built on Rebble's maintained [Clay](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@rebble/clay) framework, replacing the old custom page.

### Bluetooth disconnect alerts
- **Star Trek-themed vibration patterns:** Standard, Red Alert, Comm Chirp, Transporter, Phaser, Photon Torpedo, Warp Core Breach, Klingon Disruptor and Computer Acknowledge.
- **Optional repeat** every 10 seconds up to every 5 minutes until the phone reconnects.
- **Optional LCARS "BLUETOOTH DISCONNECTED" popup** with a live clock and customizable colors. Shake the watch to stop the buzzing, and shake again to dismiss it.
- The Bluetooth symbol flashes while disconnected.

### Watch support and look
- **All seven Pebble families:** original Pebble/Steel, Pebble Time and Time Steel, Pebble Time Round, Pebble 2 (SE and HR), Pebble Time 2, Pebble 2 Duo and Pebble Round 2, each with a layout tuned to its screen. Pebble 2 Duo and Pebble Round 2 are new.
- **The QT (Quiet Time) icon is back** in its original spot on every model, shown only while Quiet Time is on.
- **Heart rate** on supported watches, refreshed weather icons, a more readable Antonio font for small text, and a today highlight that always boxes the current day in every language.

### Weather
- **Now powered by Open-Meteo**, which needs no account or API key (replacing OpenWeather).
- **Location access is off by default.** Turn on "Use phone GPS" or type a town name.
- Refresh every 5 to 60 minutes, or hide weather entirely. When it's off, no location requests are made.

### Reliability
- **A full code audit** (see [AUDIT.md](https://github.com/nbetcher/pebbleface-trekv4/blob/master/AUDIT.md)) fixed a number of bugs, including alert repeat timings being cut to fractions of a second, a Bluetooth-vibration opt-out that could be overwritten, a saved inversion setting not being applied at startup, and no alert when the watchface started while already disconnected.
- **Phone-to-watch messages are queued and retried**, so settings and weather aren't lost when the connection is busy.
- **Weather errors keep the last reading** and retry after 30 seconds, 2 minutes and 5 minutes before returning to the normal interval.
- Old unused code was removed, including unused visual effects and an unlicensed math file.

### For developers
- **Automated tests** cover the settings schema, the settings codec and migration, watch capabilities, message queuing, the preview renderer and text layout, and the generated preview code.
- **One compact settings message.** All custom colors travel to the watch in a single validated 20-byte message, with automatic migration from older formats.
- **Builds and releases in GitHub Actions** (Actions → Build PBW) with the pinned Pebble tool 5.0.39 and SDK 4.17. Pre-releases like this one are tagged `v<version>-rcN`.
- Added LICENSE, NOTICE and third-party notices, and rewrote the README with build, test and release instructions.

### Known limitations
- Pebble Time Round's frame is still picture-based (see above).
- The original Pebble/Steel has little free memory left (about 4 KB), so please report crashes or missing elements on that model.
- The emulator and on-watch test matrix is still run by hand; please report anything that looks off on your watch.
